name: synology-mcp
display_name: Synology DSM + Active Backup for Business
description: Every client NAS's Active Backup for Business jobs and storage health, mirrored into one local SQLite database and checked with one command.

synology_base_url.title: SYNOLOGY_BASE_URL
synology_base_url.description: DSM address of the NAS, scheme and port included, for example https://nas.acme.example:5001 (HTTPS port 5001 by default).

synology_account.title: SYNOLOGY_ACCOUNT
synology_account.description: DSM account name used for the SYNO.API.Auth login. A dedicated read-mostly admin account is recommended; Active Backup for Business status calls need administrator rights.

synology_password.title: SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD
synology_password.description: DSM account password; sent in the login request body, never written to disk by the CLI.

synology_device_id.title: SYNOLOGY_DEVICE_ID (optional)
synology_device_id.description: Trusted-device token (did) from an earlier two-factor login, used instead of a one-time code. Leave blank if the account has no two-factor authentication.

synology_otp_code.title: SYNOLOGY_OTP_CODE (optional)
synology_otp_code.description: Six-digit one-time code for the first login of a two-factor account. It expires in seconds, so prefer running auth login once in a terminal and leaving this blank.

synology_tls_fingerprint.title: SYNOLOGY_TLS_FINGERPRINT (optional)
synology_tls_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the NAS certificate to pin (DSM ships a self-signed certificate). Leave blank when the NAS has a publicly trusted certificate.

synology_skip_tls_verify.title: SYNOLOGY_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY (optional)
synology_skip_tls_verify.description: Set to 1 to skip certificate verification. Prefer SYNOLOGY_TLS_FINGERPRINT; leave blank otherwise.

synology_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server (optional)
synology_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to drop the MCP tools that start or cancel backups or change local state. Leave blank for the full tool set.

synology_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token (optional)
synology_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http; the server refuses to start without it. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
